column1: #phenotype: leave trait name unchanged for harmonisation with other cohorts
#sst_file: please supply the absolute file path of your summary stats under sst_path matching the trait
#n_gwas: total GWAS sample size (adjust to Leave-one-out GWAS sample sizes)
#snp_col: name of the SNP identifier column in the summary statistics (e.g. SNP, rsid)
#effect_allele_col: name of the effect allele column
column2: this allele will be renamed to A1 for PRS-CS

column1: #other_allele_col: name of the non-effect/other allele column
column2: this allele will be renamed to A2 for PRS-CS

column1: #effect_col: name of the effect-size column in the summary statistics
#effect_type: type of effect size provided in effect_col
column2: must be BETA or OR (BETA preferred)

column1: #stat_col: name of the statistical uncertainty/significance column in the summary statistics
#stat_type: type of statistic provided in stat_col
column2: must be SE or P (SE preferred)
